snippet.title: The Sons of Bostan | Official Teaser (EN SUB/DUB)
snippet.description:
Nine years later, he comes home. A family on the Black Sea coast, a debt, and a score no one has forgotten.

The Sons of Bostan is a story-driven open-world crime game. Drive through the city, take to the sea, run the family business, and find out what happened to your father.

• Story-driven open world
• Cars, motorcycles and boats
• Voiced in 16 languages
• iPhone, iPad and Mac

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6825755740
